container_info.description: The Recipe Finding App is designed to identify food items from user-uploaded images and provide the full recipe for the recognized dish, along with links to the original sources. The application leverages AI-powered image recognition to analyze food photos, retrieves detailed recipes from trusted databases or APIs, and presents them in a user-friendly format. The app aims to make it easy for users to recreate dishes they encounter in daily life, ensuring transparency by always including source links for each recipe.

React is widely used for image-upload UIs, works well with TypeScript, is supported by create-react-app already present in the image, and is a lightweight default for web frontends in this environment.

steps.name: environment
steps.description: Validate Node/npm available and persist NODE_ENV=development and npm global bin on PATH system-wide via /etc/profile.d. Ensures node and npm meet minimal versions and environment persists into future shells. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/webfrontend_node.sh
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
if ! sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "sudo required and must be passwordless" >&2; exit 2; fi
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 3; }
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 4; }
NODE_V=$(node --version | sed 's/^v//')
NPM_V=$(npm --version)
ver_ge(){ printf '%s\n%s' "$2" "$1" | sort -V | head -n1 | grep -qx "$2"; }
if ! ver_ge "$NODE_V" "16"; then echo "node >=16 required (found $NODE_V)" >&2; exit 5; fi
if ! ver_ge "$NPM_V" "8"; then echo "npm >=8 recommended (found $NPM_V)" >&2; exit 6; fi
NPM_GLOB_BIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$NPM_GLOB_BIN" ] || [ ! -d "$NPM_GLOB_BIN" ]; then
  if [ -d "/usr/local/bin" ]; then NPM_GLOB_BIN="/usr/local/bin"; elif [ -d "/usr/bin" ]; then NPM_GLOB_BIN="/usr/bin"; else NPM_GLOB_BIN=""; fi
fi
TMP=/tmp/webfrontend_node.sh
cat >"$TMP" <<'EOF'
export NODE_ENV=development
EOF
if [ -n "$NPM_GLOB_BIN" ]; then cat >>"$TMP" <<EOF
export PATH="$NPM_GLOB_BIN":\${PATH}
EOF
fi
if ! sudo test -f "$PROFILE" || ! sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$PROFILE"; then sudo cp "$TMP" "$PROFILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"; fi
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
. "$PROFILE" || true
if [ -n "$NPM_GLOB_BIN" ]; then echo "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -qx "$NPM_GLOB_BIN" || { echo "profile PATH does not include $NPM_GLOB_BIN" >&2; exit 7; }; fi

steps.name: project scaffolding
steps.description: Idempotently scaffold a minimal React app into the workspace. Prefer Create React App (CRA) via npx or npm exec (preinstalled). Support CREATE_TOOL=vite. If network/scaffold fails, create a minimal package.json, src files, and .env so dependency installation can proceed. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend" cd "$WORKSPACE" mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" [ -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ] && exit 0 export CI=1 BROWSER=none CREATE_TOOL=${CREATE_TOOL:-cra} LOG=/tmp/webfrontend_scaffold.log; :>"$LOG" PROJECT_DIR_NAME=$(basename "$WORKSPACE") SAFE_NAME=$(echo "$PROJECT_DIR_NAME" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed -E 's/[^a-z0-9._-]+/-/g' | sed -E 's/^-+|-+$//g' | cut -c1-214) SAFE_NAME=${SAFE_NAME:-app} RETRY=0; MAX_RETRY=2; sleep_backoff(){ sleep $((2**$1)); } if [ "$CREATE_TOOL" = "vite" ]; then until (command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx --yes create-vite@latest . -- --template react >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG") || (command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm exec --yes create-vite@latest -- . --template react >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG"); do RETRY=$((RETRY+1)) || true [ "$RETRY" -gt "$MAX_RETRY" ] && break sleep_backoff "$RETRY" done else tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT cd "$tmpdir" until (command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx --yes create-react-app@latest "$SAFE_NAME" --use-npm --skip-install >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG") || (command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm exec --yes create-react-app@latest -- "$SAFE_NAME" --use-npm --skip-install >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG"); do RETRY=$((RETRY+1)) || true [ "$RETRY" -gt "$MAX_RETRY" ] && break sleep_backoff "$RETRY" done if [ -d "$tmpdir/$SAFE_NAME" ]; then mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" rsync -a --exclude node_modules --exclude ".git" "$tmpdir/$SAFE_NAME/" "$WORKSPACE/" cd "$WORKSPACE" if [ -f package.json ]; then if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then tmp_pkg=$(mktemp); jq --arg n "$SAFE_NAME" '.name=$n' package.json > "$tmp_pkg" && mv "$tmp_pkg" package.json; else sed -E "s/\"name\":\s*\"[^"]*\"/\"name\": \"$SAFE_NAME\"/" package.json > package.json.tmp && mv package.json.tmp package.json; fi fi fi fi # If scaffolding didn't create package.json (offline/failure), create a minimal package.json + src if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ]; then cat > "$WORKSPACE/package.json" < "$WORKSPACE/src/index.js" <<'EOF' import React from 'react' import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client' import App from './App' const root = document.getElementById('root') || document.createElement('div') root.id = 'root' createRoot(root).render() EOF cat > "$WORKSPACE/src/App.js" <<'EOF' import React from 'react' export default function App(){return (
App
)} EOF fi if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/.env" ]; then cat > "$WORKSPACE/.env" < /tmp/webfrontend_scaffold_tool.txt

steps.name: install dependencies
steps.description: Install Node dependencies in the workspace. Depends on scaffold-002 which guarantees package.json exists. Prefer deterministic installs (npm ci if package-lock.json exists, yarn --frozen-lockfile when yarn.lock present), otherwise npm install. Install testing dev deps and TypeScript typings when TypeScript detected. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/package.json" ]; then echo "package.json missing; scaffold-002 must run first" >&2; exit 5; fi
LOG=/tmp/webfrontend_install.log; :>"$LOG"
USE_YARN=0
if [ "${YARN:-0}" = "1" ] || [ -f "$WORKSPACE/yarn.lock" ]; then USE_YARN=1; fi
RETRY=0; MAX_RETRY=2; sleep_backoff(){ sleep $((2**$1)); }
if [ "$USE_YARN" -eq 1 ]; then
  until yarn install --frozen-lockfile --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1; do
    RETRY=$((RETRY+1)) || true
    [ "$RETRY" -gt "$MAX_RETRY" ] && { echo "yarn install failed; see $LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 6; }
    sleep_backoff "$RETRY"
  done
else
  if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/package-lock.json" ]; then
    until npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1; do
      RETRY=$((RETRY+1)) || true
      [ "$RETRY" -gt "$MAX_RETRY" ] && { echo "npm ci failed; see $LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 7; }
      sleep_backoff "$RETRY"
    done
  else
    until npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent >"$LOG" 2>&1; do
      RETRY=$((RETRY+1)) || true
      [ "$RETRY" -gt "$MAX_RETRY" ] && { echo "npm install failed; see $LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 8; }
      sleep_backoff "$RETRY"
    done
  fi
fi
# Verify essential deps present after install
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{}); if(!deps['react']||!deps['react-dom']){console.error('missing react/react-dom'); process.exit(2);} if(!deps['react-scripts']&&!deps['vite']){console.error('neither react-scripts nor vite detected'); process.exit(3);}console.log('deps_ok');" >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "Dependency verification failed; inspect $LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 9; }
# Ensure testing libraries exist (install if missing)
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({},p.devDependencies||{},p.dependencies||{}); if(!deps.jsdom||!deps['@testing-library/react']||!deps['@testing-library/jest-dom']) process.exit(1); process.exit(0);" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
  if [ "$USE_YARN" -eq 1 ]; then yarn add --dev @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom jsdom --silent >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "yarn add dev deps failed; see $LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 10; }; else npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent --save-dev @testing-library/react @testing-library/jest-dom jsdom >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "npm add dev deps failed; see $LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 11; } fi
}
# TypeScript detection and typings
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/tsconfig.json" ] || node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if((p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies.typescript)||(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.typescript)) process.exit(0); process.exit(1);" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({},p.devDependencies||{},p.dependencies||{}); if(!deps['@types/react']||!deps['@types/react-dom']) process.exit(1); process.exit(0);" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    if [ "$USE_YARN" -eq 1 ]; then yarn add --dev @types/react @types/react-dom --silent >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true; else npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent --save-dev @types/react @types/react-dom >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true; fi
  }
fi

The script implements deterministic installs: uses yarn with --frozen-lockfile when yarn.lock present or YARN=1, uses npm ci when package-lock.json exists, otherwise falls back to npm install. Depends on env-001, scaffold-002, deps-003, test-004. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98491/WebFrontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
export CI=1 BROWSER=none
BUILD_LOG=/tmp/webfrontend_build.log; :>"$BUILD_LOG"
# determine build command
if node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{}); process.exit(deps['react-scripts']?0:1)" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  BUILD_CMD="npm run build --silent"
elif node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); const deps=Object.assign({},p.dependencies||{},p.devDependencies||{}); process.exit(deps['vite']?0:1)" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  BUILD_CMD="npm run build --silent"
else
  echo "No known build tool (react-scripts or vite) found" >&2; exit 10
fi
eval "$BUILD_CMD" >"$BUILD_LOG" 2>&1 || { echo "build failed; see $BUILD_LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$BUILD_LOG" >&2; exit 11; }
if [ -d "$WORKSPACE/build" ]; then BUILD_DIR="$WORKSPACE/build"; elif [ -d "$WORKSPACE/dist" ]; then BUILD_DIR="$WORKSPACE/dist"; else echo "build artifacts missing" >&2; exit 12; fi
if [ -f "$BUILD_DIR/index.html" ]; then cp "$BUILD_DIR/index.html" /tmp/webfrontend_index_full.html; else echo "index.html not found in build dir" >&2; exit 13; fi
if ! grep -E "<div[^>]*id=[\"']root[\"']" /tmp/webfrontend_index_full.html >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "index missing <div id=\"root\">" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' /tmp/webfrontend_index_full.html >&2; exit 14; fi
PORT=${PORT:-8000}
if ss -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -q ":${PORT}$"; then echo "port $PORT in use; set PORT env to another port" >&2; exit 15; fi
cd "$BUILD_DIR"
LOG=/tmp/webfrontend_serve.log; :>"$LOG"
python3 -m http.server "$PORT" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
trap 'kill ${PID} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
for i in {1..20}; do sleep 1; if curl -sS "http://localhost:$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then echo "server died; see $LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 16; fi; if [ "$i" -eq 20 ]; then echo "server did not respond" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$LOG" >&2; exit 17; fi; done
curl -sS "http://localhost:$PORT" > /tmp/webfrontend_index_served.html || true
cat > /tmp/webfrontend_setup_summary.json <<EOF
{
  "status":"success",
  "build_dir":"${BUILD_DIR}",
  "index_saved":"/tmp/webfrontend_index_full.html",
  "served_index":"/tmp/webfrontend_index_served.html",
  "logs":{
    "build":"${BUILD_LOG}",
    "serve":"/tmp/webfrontend_serve.log",
    "install":"/tmp/webfrontend_install.log",
    "test":"/tmp/webfrontend_test.log"
  }
}
EOF
echo "validation_success: build served on http://localhost:${PORT}; summary at /tmp/webfrontend_setup_summary.json"
